audit.whatIsWrong: The shield is credited to Sion's passive in three places ('his shield passive'), and Roar of the Slayer is described only as poke.
audit.why: Glory in Death is the post-death reanimation — rapid attacks that heal him and deal max-health bonus damage. The shield is Soul Furnace (W), 15/14/13/12/11s, 500 range, with a 3-second reactivation for magic damage. Roar of the Slayer slows AND reduces armour on the first target, and knocks a minion back through everything behind it — the armour shred is what makes his follow-up hurt and it was never on the page.
audit.corrected: Shield attributed to Soul Furnace; Glory in Death named for the zombie form; the armour reduction on his E stated in early, spikes[2] and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Sion's HP/resist stacking outpaces your burst; his charged Q knockup into E can chunk you before your Silver Stake on-hits do enough.
edits.after: Sion's HP stacking outpaces your burst; his E strips your armour and Soul Furnace (W) eats the burst you land, so his charged Q chunks you first.

edits.after: Early is a skill phase — respect his charged Q (Decimating Smash), which knocks you up for a full trade, and his E (Roar of the Slayer), which slows and shreds your armour. Only step up for Q (Ritual Nails) marks while his abilities are down; your on-hits work, but Soul Furnace (W) eats a lot of it.

edits.before: From level 4 Sion tilts the lane his way: his knockup threat zones you, and at 6 his R (Unstoppable Onslaught) plus zombie passive make him nearly un-killable in lane — even a good R (Purgatory) execute just sends him into raging zombie form to keep swinging. Don't over-commit into his engage.
edits.after: From level 4 Sion tilts the lane his way: his knockup threat zones you, and at 6 his R (Unstoppable Onslaught) — 140 seconds at rank 1 — plus Glory in Death make him nearly un-killable in lane, since a good R (Purgatory) execute just sends him into zombie form to keep swinging. Don't over-commit into his engage.

edits.before: Poke with E (Roar of the Slayer) to keep his passive shield and HP advantage
edits.after: Poke with E (Roar of the Slayer) to slow you and cut your armour down

notes: Sion's shield is Soul Furnace (W) on 15/14/13/12/11s, not his passive — Glory in Death is the post-death reanimation, and the page conflated the two. Roar of the Slayer's armour reduction was missing entirely; it is why his follow-up damage lands so much harder than the poke number suggests. I did not touch the claim that his zombie form 'undoes' the Purgatory execute — reanimation after death is in Riot's text, but whether an execute interacts with it differently is not, so I left the existing wording rather than sharpening it.
